definitions.explanation: How likely something is to happen, judged from the circumstances. A news and formal word, almost always in 〜{公算|こうさん}が{大|おお}きい / {強|つよ}い (it is likely that ~) or 〜{公算|こうさん}が{小|ちい}さい.

examples.japanese: ⟦{当選|とうせん}→当選：07074_tousen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{公算|こうさん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: The candidate is likely to be elected.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{延期|えんき}→延期：01888_enki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧{公算|こうさん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: The match will very probably be postponed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧、⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ずれ{込|こ}む{公算|こうさん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧。
examples.english: According to experts, the economic recovery is likely to slip into next year.

notes:
Typical of newspaper and broadcast reporting. The homophone ⟦{降参|こうさん}→降参：15127_kousan⟧ means surrender.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜{公算|こうさん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧: it is highly likely that ~
- 〜{公算|こうさん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ / ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: there is a strong likelihood that ~
- 〜{公算|こうさん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧: it is unlikely that ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見込|みこ}み→見込み：06872_mikomi⟧: prospect, expectation; everyday and broader
- ⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧: possibility; the general word
- ⟦{確率|かくりつ}→確率：00159_kakuritsu⟧: probability as a number or percentage
